traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: petals linear-subulate, inconspicuous; stamens 10, long and slender; calyx adherent only to the very base of the ovary. The Flora of North America's genus (as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read): hypanthium barely adnate to the ovary; carpels 2, unequal, connate.
